SharedThought.title: SharedThought
SharedThought.description: Anonymously shared infinite canvas thought dump with vector strokes and semantic clustering metadata.

title.description: Title or headline of the thought dump

summary.description: Algorithmic semantic summary used for stranger clustering

category.description: Dynamic category cluster assigned by the scaling recommendation engine

authorAnonymousId.description: Hashed anonymous client identifier with zero personally identifying information

expiresAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds after which the thought dump expires from live feed

reactionCount.description: Total sum of community anonymous reactions

reactions.description: Map of reaction counts (e.g. resonate, inspire, reflect, empathy)

canvasPayload.description: JSON serialized canvas elements for full infinite canvas interactive replay

ThoughtReaction.title: ThoughtReaction
ThoughtReaction.description: Anonymous reaction event sent from a stranger to a shared thought dump.

thoughtId.description: ID of the shared thought document

reactionType.description: Type of reaction (e.g. resonate, inspire, reflect, empathy)

authorAnonymousId.description: Anonymous hash of the reacting visitor

AppFeedback.title: AppFeedback
AppFeedback.description: Community user rating and feedback submission for Thoughtspace.

/sharedThoughts/{thoughtId}.description: Global live feed of anonymous thought dumps accessible to all visitors.

/sharedThoughts/{thoughtId}/reactions/{r.description: Subcollection of non-comment anonymous reaction events for a thought dump.
